8.3
Ενεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου, τοῦ κα ταλῦσαι ἐχθρὸν καὶ ἐκδικητήν. ̓Ωρ. ̔Ως ἐχθρὸς μὲν
ἡμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς ἁμαρ τάνειν καταναγκάζει· ὡς δὲ ἐκδικητὴς, πα ραδιδομένους
κολάζει, ̔Υμέναιον ου ν καὶ ̓Αλέξανδρον αὐτὸς βλασφήμους ἀπεργασά μενος, πάλιν
ἐπαίδευσεν, διὰ τὰς εἰς Θεὸν βλασφημίας.
pass_a_gloss: Because-of the enemies of-you, of-the to-destroy enemy and avenger. Origen. As enemy on-the-one-hand us the Satan to-sin he-compels; as and avenger, those-being-handed-over he-punishes, Hymenaeus then and Alexander himself blasphemers having-made, again he-disciplined, through the against God blasphemies.
pass_b_english: “Because of your enemies, to destroy enemy and avenger” (Psalm 8:3).

Origen. As enemy, Satan forces us to sin; as avenger, he punishes those who are handed over. So Hymenaeus and Alexander, having himself made them blasphemers, he again disciplined, because of the blasphemies against God (1 Timothy 1:20).

choices.why: Two roles of Satan: he forces sin, then punishes those handed over. Not two separate persons.
